pull_request.body:
Revert the direct better-successor framing to an experience-causal one:
the target is a factory whose production experience causes retained
changes that later work depends on, with improvement judged separately
by comparing snapshot factory states under the fixed declared
comparison. The successor becomes a measurement boundary on a
continuous, interleaved process — matching how current agentic coding
systems actually retain learning — rather than the product of one
discrete construction episode, which a capable builder could produce
from the specification alone without learning anything.

Two guardrails come with the revert. The successor-construction
experiment gains a history-withholding intervention so learning versus
construction is a contrast the experiment actually runs, and the
Commonplace testbed paragraph names the production-time instrumentation
cost the interleaved view incurs. Theory acquisition is stated as
commitment, not reorganization of information the experience already
contains: a theory conjectures mechanisms beyond the observed cases and
resolves choices because production needed some resolution, which is
the structural source of its fallibility and why raw-record retrieval
is a named competing baseline rather than an equivalent.
